title: Dock, detach, return
description: A floating shape inspector previews edge docking and returns to its previous position without losing its properties.
useCase: Reclaim canvas space while keeping inspector state and keyboard focus intact.
interaction: Drag the title to an allowed edge, use the dock buttons, or move with arrow keys. Detach restores the prior floating position.
reducedMotion: Panel transforms settle immediately for keyboard input, reduced motion and inactive hosts. Host pause and pointer cancellation restore the pre-drag state.
limitations: One inspector and one original lightning icon. Docking is local component state, not a general window manager. The inspector changes corner radius, fill and outline; editor configuration controls docking behavior separately.
look: Neutral dotted drafting canvas, a yellow or vermilion lightning icon, and one compact white inspector with a title grip and edge-dock buttons.
motion: The inspector tracks the title drag directly; a pale target marks an eligible edge. Release settles its transform over 180 ms, while the canvas reserves the docked width. Detach restores the last free position.
adapt: `mode`, `position` and `lastFree` keep docking separate from `radius`, `fill` and `stroke`. `cancel` restores the drag snapshot. Override `DEFAULT_CONFIG` through the `config` prop; inputs remain mounted across dock transitions.
